title: Handshake preflight: open questions & action threads (2026-08-23)
content:
Meeting: Handshake preflight / weekly triage (standup-style)
Date: 2026-08-23
Facilitator: Maya Lin
Attendees: Maya, Jonah, Priya, Ethan, Sara, + field engineer: Carlos (recorded via Slack thread)

Purpose: capture open questions before next-week customer handoffs and consolidate action threads. This is a working note — not final runbook.

Top-line summary:
- Progress: 3 installs green from last week (smaller customers), 2 installs still blocked on networking/firewall questions, 1 on KMS/HSM integration.
- Biggest risk this sprint: inconsistent MTU/path MTU behavior across customer edge routers leading to slow TLS renegotiation during image pulls.
- Decision: pause new day-one handoffs for cohort-gamma until MTU mitigation validated in sandbox (target: 48 hours).

Notes & findings (raw):
- MTU behavior: Jonah reproduced symmetric fragmentation on customer-edge with VXLAN+MPLS. Workaround (temporary) is to set host-side docker MTU to 1400 and enforce TCP MSS clamping at firewall. Customer network team reluctant to change global rules.
- TLS stalls during large model fetches: observed ~30s stalls when pulling 14GB artifact from S3-proxy behind corporate proxy. Likely compounded by small MTU/path anomalies and proxy chunking.
- KMS/HSM: Customer A requires HSM-backed envelope keys. Our current private-deploy package supports KMS integration via AWS KMS and Vault; HSM flow not fully documented. Risk: cannot sign images with customer attestation until HSM and CI handoff are validated.
- DNS split-horizon case: Customer B has internal names for control-plane endpoints (redwood-control.local) — we need to ship resolv.conf patches or documented stub-zone instructions.
- Port expectations: Engineering noted that default firewall spec in the preflight doc omitted ephemeral ports used by sidecar health checks (range 49152-49200). This caused intermittent sidecar OOMs during initial reconnections.

Customer-specific bullets:
- Customer: AtlasFin (on-prem)
  - Blocker: internal proxy insertion drops chunked responses >8MB.
  - Temp mitigation: enable artifact prefetch to local cache host (we will provide small NBD-backed cache image).
  - Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-08-25 (provide cache image + deployment guide).

- Customer: Meridian Health (VPC)
  - Blocker: KMS/HSM attestation requirement. Customer wants FIPS audit trail and hardware-backed key storage.
  - Action: Ethan to schedule 1:1 with customer security (Wed 08/25) and map HSM provider (Luna vs. Thales).
  - Linked artifact: JIRA-1428 (HSM mapping).

- Customer: NovaApps (edge)
  - Blocker: MTU mismatch causing long pulls and occasional container crash loops on day-two.
  - Action: Jonah to produce a short reproducible test case and a sandbox patch to set docker MTU + MSS clamp.
  - Decision: don't change customer-wide router rules; use host-level config until we have an ops-approved patch.

Action items (owners + next steps):
1) Priya: produce and post AtlasFin artifact cache image + quickstart doc. (Due: 2026-08-25)
2) Ethan: HSM discovery meeting + outcome notes; list supported HSM integration paths and known gaps. (Due: 2026-08-26)
3) Jonah: MTU reproducible test + patch for sandbox, include performance numbers and failure cases observed. (Due: 2026-08-24)
4) Maya: update preflight checklist to explicitly call out ephemeral port range and DNS stub-zone steps; include a short decision tree for artifact prefetch vs. inline fetch. (Due: 2026-08-24)
5) Sara: add a short runbook appendix for TLS pull stalls (what to check: MTU, corporate proxy chunking, curl/openssl probes). (Due: 2026-08-25)

Open questions for product/infra:
- Rollback semantics: If we enable host-level MTU adjustments, should the deploy agent revert them on uninstall? (Risk: touching host networking could conflict with customer router configs). Need product decision.
- KMS/HSM: do we require customers to provide a PKCS#11 interface endpoint, or can we support an out-of-band attestation flow where signing occurs on customer side and we accept a signed envelope?
- Observability: what minimal telemetry can we ask customers to expose pre-handshake (we want CPU/iface/MTU, but privacy team flagged interface stats as potentially sensitive).

Incidents and recent mitigations:
- 08/21: NovaApps install loop — root cause traced to kernel driver for NIC (firmware mismatch). Short term: pinned kernel module for installer container. Long term: add firmware compatibility check to node preflight.
- 08/20: Failed image signature verification on one host — turned out to be clock skew >300s against KMS server. Mitigation: added NTP check to preflight and a soft-fail warning in console.

Runbook & docs changes required (short list):
- Preflight checklist: add ephemeral port range and DNS stub-zone examples (Maya).
- Artifacts: add artifact-prefetch pattern + troubleshooting steps (Priya + Sara).
- KMS/HSM: create a short HSM integration FAQ mapping providers and expected interfaces (Ethan).
- Sandbox: add MTU test harness and documented repro case (Jonah).

Risks / severity matrix:
- High: KMS/HSM integration gap for regulated customers (blocks go-live).
- Medium: MTU/proxy-induced TLS stalls (causes degraded user experience and longer deploy windows).
- Low: missing ephemeral port doc (causes intermittent OOMs but recoverable).

Meeting decisions & follow-ups:
- Pause cohort-gamma handoffs until sandbox MTU patch validated (Maya to communicate to Success).
- Prioritize HSM workstream for next sprint (Ethan + Product security sync).

Next sync: 2026-08-25 09:30 PT (15 min standup). Agenda: MTU patch results, HSM meeting notes, AtlasFin cache progress.

Notes-to-self / scribbles:
- Consider adding a small prescriptive patch: /etc/docker/daemon.json -> {"mtu": 1400} + systemd drop-in for iptables mss clamp on node. But must include uninstall path.
- Add a checkbox in concierge ticket for: "customer security contact provided" and "HSM vendor + interface specified".

Attachments to prepare before next handoff:
- small artifact-cache image (tar + manifest)
- MTU sandbox repro script (simple iperf + image-pull case)
- HSM provider compatibility matrix (one-pager)

End of notes.
